name: K-KUT System Map
purpose: Identify each K-KUT part, loop, pathway, endpoint, purpose, proof, and safety gate so the platform functions perfectly and in harmony.

public_buyer_paths.user_goal: Understand HUGs and buy a regular/basic HUG.
proof: checkout link present or route available
location is regular HUG Stripe link

public_buyer_paths.purpose: Find/Search entry for KKs and HUG use cases.
public_buyer_paths.user_goal: Find suitable KKs by feeling, theme, or scenario.
Understand this lane is under human review.

high_risk_lanes.reason: Grief, remembrance, memorial, and celebration-of-life require approved intent-safe KK registry before public selection.

kkr_internal_loops.purpose: Readings/reviews/metagrabs are preserved per PIX and per KK before buyer categories are derived.
kkr_internal_loops.rule: KKr does not primarily search categories. KKr maintains interpretations per PIX and per KK.

kkr_internal_loops.purpose: Map KKs by verb + object + situation + direction + opposite-risk + evidence.
kkr_internal_loops.rule: No one-term search. No title-only search.

kkr_internal_loops.purpose: Map KK interpretations to Top 100 Shared Emotions before buyer-lane use.
kkr_internal_loops.rule: User scenarios map to shared emotions; shared emotions map to suitable KKs.

more_logic.label: More for this feeling
more_logic.purpose: Expand across the catalog for the same emotional need.
more_logic.limit_rule: Stop after two More pages unless user refines.

more_logic.label: More from this track
more_logic.purpose: Expand within the same PIX/source track.
more_logic.limit_rule: Show only suitable KKs from same source.

global_laws: KKs per search are suitability-limited, not number-limited.
Approved does not mean published unless all gates pass.
Published does not mean payable unless payment_allowed is true.
High-risk intent lanes cannot publish from raw title, one-term search, or mood metadata.
Public buyer UI must not expose mK / mini-KUT / mini language by default.
